parameters.help_en:
The unique, one-use client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. It can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you leave this parameter empty, the system automatically uses the **request ID** as the **client token**
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the flow log.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh:
流日志的新名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: flow_log_name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the flow log.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh:
流日志新的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the flow log is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
流日志所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the flow log
parameters.name: flow_log_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The duraton of the capture window. Unit: seconds. Valid values: **60** and **600**. Default value: **600**
parameters.help_zh: 流日志捕获流量的捕获窗口时长。单位：秒。取值：**60**或**600**。默认值：**600**
parameters.name: interval
